recordSet.description: Station metadata from Agencija Republike Slovenije za okolje (ARSO), published through the ARSO hydrological archive (https://vode.arso.gov.si/hidarhiv/) and listed on Open Data Slovenia (https://podatki.gov.si/) under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0) with required attribution to Agencija Republike Slovenije za okolje (ARSO). RivRetrieve selected the declared station-name, water-body-name, and drainage-area scalars (preserving documented ARSO indeterminable-catchment codes 88888.88 and 99999.99 verbatim as native values); source strings and absence states remain unchanged.
